sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 510. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 80 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Ability Power buff limit for physical attacks by 40 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Ability Power buff limit for magic attacks by 40 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 90 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Ambush for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; reduces the cooldown time of Abilities to 0 (except for certain Abilities); nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Fire Qualia (increases all stats by 100%, increases fire elemental attack by 10, increases fire elemental defense by 150, and nullifies Scorching and Blind) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases your character's max HP by 50% when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Fire, Water, Wind, Light, Dark, Time, and Star elemental attack by 10 for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
Fire and Dark Defense from Unison Damage +500
